summary: Reselect reconciliation after deferred replicated projection completes

schema.detail: No DDL, index, migration or storage-format change.

rules.detail: Admission, canonical ordering, checkpoint and effect authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A process/Store-lifetime opaque observation of the existing replicated-projection generation and deferred bit conservatively reselects cached evaluations on token change and while projection is pending. Same-frontier completion cannot leave consumed claim hints certified clean, including when the pending interval was unseen.

downtime.detail: No added downtime; no deployment is implied.

recovery.detail: A second atomic sample after the released hint read detects capture races; retain the pre-read token so a stale supplied input recorded afterward is selected on the next observation. Failed feed reads do not advance that token. Existing generation mutations, projection commit/CAS/notification ordering and producer policy are unchanged. This adds no SQL, timer, queue or cache of authority; pending and changed projection states deliberately invalidate all retained items. Replay/heal/all projection paths, OLD/removal/gap coverage and generation wrap are not certified. Off disables intake skipping and fatal entry reads, not all guarded diagnostics or historical byte identity. Current-source controls and production under500 remain pending.
